subject: Evaluation kickoff: Redwood trial plan & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, Devon Patel <devon.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + proposed evaluation kickoff (Redwood trial plan & success criteria)

Hi Sarah + Devon,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning - really helpful to understand Acme's priorities around reducing latency on customer-facing recommendations and ensuring embeddings quality for search. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can line up the evaluation kickoff:

- Goal: Validate whether Redwood's dedicated inference and caching strategies can meet Acme's 99th %-ile latency <= 120ms for 512-token requests and maintain retrieval-relevance uplift >= 8% on your benchmark prompt set.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  * Latency: 99th %-ile <= 120ms (95% of traffic)
  * Quality: >8% improvement on Acme A/B retrieval metric vs. current baseline
  * Cost target: <=$X per 1k requests (we'll surface post-quantization numbers)
- Scope: 2-week evaluation using a dedicated-small pool, your sample prompts + 10k synthetic queries, and the eval prompt set you mentioned.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff / technical deep dive where we align on trial plan, share the eval prompt set, and surface integration steps (data ingestion, connectors, security). Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Dec 1, 10:00-11:00am
- Tue Dec 1, 3:00-4:00pm
- Wed Dec 2, 9:00-10:00am

Connor will join to cover infra, data connectors, and the prompt/eval plan. Neha (CS lead) will be looped in on the trial run and success monitoring.

I've attached a short eval plan and a starter prompt set for your review. If those times don't work, tell me your availability and we'll align.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
redwood.com

Excellent - locking Tue Dec 1, 3:00-4:00pm PST. I've sent a calendar invite (link below).

To answer your questions:
- Sample data: a small subset (1-2GB) is helpful pre-kickoff for Connor to validate connectors, but it's optional for the kickoff itself. If you can provide a service account with read-only access to the S3 bucket or a sample export, that will speed the initial setup.
- Connor will cover quantization, pool sizing, and the expected perf/cost tradeoffs across the recommended configurations. Neha will walk through success monitoring and the eval dashboard we'll spin up for Acme.

Proposed kickoff agenda (60m):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Architecture & data/connectors (15m)
3) Eval plan, prompt set, and metrics (20m)
4) Next steps, timeline, and roles (15m)

Connor / Neha - can you confirm you can join at 3pm PST and whether you want the sample data ahead of time?

Related links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=eval-kickoff-acme , HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/contacts/ACME-12345

Thanks - Marissa
